title: ATM Problem
description: The ATM kept your card - get help at the bank
systemPrompt: You work at bank. Customer's card got stuck in ATM. Need passport to verify identity. Card will be returned in 2 days. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User reported ATM problem and you arranged card return.
hints: Банкомат забрал мою карту (The ATM took my card)
Что мне делать? (What should I do?)
У меня есть паспорт (I have my passport)
objectives: Explain the ATM took your card (забрал карту)
